fields.Name: C1 -> S1.3
fields.Description: Gate G2.22 (phase 2, dataset C1, criterion S1.3): the declared last-year-renewed heuristic is scored on the same holdout as a named comparator, 1 of 1, and a model that does not beat it by the margin ends in a stored keep-the-heuristic outcome with its reason. C1 trains through MJAPI on the year-cutoff holdout and on its reference split; on each the check requires the heuristic's baseline row with both bounds and the stored heuristic:renewed last yearVsDummy and modelVs:heuristic:renewed last year comparisons, and a stored decision that agrees with the model-versus-rule comparison (a model that beats the rule never ships it; one that does not ships no model, carries its reason, and keeps the rule only as heuristic-carries-signal). On both holdouts the model beats the rule (measured), so the runtime gate exercises the beats-it side; the keep-the-heuristic branch is Core's gate.test.ts (treats the unit incumbent heuristic as a simple member, heuristic-carries-signal). It fails when the snapshot omits the incumbent-score column (no comparator stored).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: On both C1 holdouts the heuristic is stored as a named comparator with both bounds and the stored decision agrees with the model-versus-rule comparison.
